scientific_integrity: One exact second-moment identity for stopped threshold-reset excursions and its regenerative Gaussian occupation-fraction consequence. The proof uses a natural-scale Brownian time change, a Dirichlet Green kernel and a Poisson-potential energy identity. Symbolic and finite checks corroborate algebra but do not establish theorem priority.
scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional continuum diffusion with generator |x|^(-alpha) d2/dx2, alpha>=0, symmetric absorbing thresholds +/-L, instantaneous fixed positive restart x0=rho L with 0<rho<1, and fixed-parameter large observation time. No lattice or higher-dimensional claim; endpoint values are one-sided coefficient limits.
title: Universal centered-cycle variance for threshold-reset sluggish diffusion
